name: Mizusawa Ryouko
source:
A girl Riku met by chance.

An office lady who frequently buys Genji's takoyaki, always coming with a colleague named Tomoko. But every time she comes, Genji seems to act strange...

She is overall a refreshing and gentle woman.

[Translated from [url=https://www.akabeesoft3.com/products/bokuumi/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
